description: Morphology grammar: role -> select -> extrude/subdivide -> recurse with budget decay.

configs.notes: Body cube extrudes into a trunk, fans into three branches, then caps tips with clustered leaves.
Flat palm body allocates a five-finger zone, extrudes finger trunks, then extends phalange segments from each tip.
Main body box subdivides its front wall into door and window apertures, then caps the top with a pitched roof.
A single tabletop body allocates four corner supports from its underside, keeping the main mass broad and the supports delayed to a lower-depth decision.
A seat body keeps its broad slab, drops four corner legs, then folds its rear band upward into a backrest instead of attaching a separate mesh.
A tall body is carved into repeated front bays so the hierarchy reads as frame first, compartments second, stored things implied last.
A work-plane body allocates support legs from below and drawer recesses from the front, keeping the desk as one volume with differentiated depth.
A torso-scale body extends two arm trunks, then continues their terminal panels into forearm and hand-scale segments before splitting the ends into small terminals.
Palm mass allocates five fingers, then each finger extends one more phalange step so the scale ladder stays visible from palm to fingertip.
A pageant silhouette: narrow torso, amplified gown volume, trailing train, and a swept wig held in one continuous body grammar.
A club-kid body pushes out platform heels, an angled shoulder rig, a compact corset front, and a tilted spiked headpiece rather than a conventional gown.
An avant-garde silhouette grows a slung train-cape, one dominant sleeve, a reduced counter-arm, and a skewed headpiece from the same body seed.
Reference-driven mermaid glam: a narrow lower column that breaks into a late trumpet flare, with a compact swept wig and restrained shoulder sparkle.
Reference-driven bloom silhouette: petal shoulders and a ballooning upper dress grow from the torso while the body stays legible underneath.
Reference-driven spike armor: hard shoulder growth, a smaller rear shroud, and a hostile headpiece turn the body into a sharp performance shell.
Reference-driven contour suit: platform legs, a tight central body, angular hip fins, and a rigid shoulder line push the silhouette into graphic club territory.
Transform-led pageant look: a narrow gown opens into a slipped side train, with a tilted wig slab and one restrained shoulder bloom.
Transform-led club-kid look: platform legs, a cutout torso frame, one shifted shoulder rig, and a displaced headpiece push the silhouette into harsher queer club territory.
Transform-led avant-garde look: a large rear veil is rotated into a folded plane, one arm becomes a hard frame, and the headpiece slips off-axis.
Transform-led chapel drag: a column body carries a broken halo collar, a side-shifted veil train, and a rigid wig block that feels ceremonial rather than polite.
Reference-driven cradle chair: a padded seat grows side bolsters, a rear shell, and an overhead support arm from one continuous body.
Reference-driven petal lounger: a low chaise with a carved plinth, a side fin, and a thickened seat bowl assembled from a few large mass decisions.
Reference-driven step perch: an upright seat shell with a small stair-like front assembly and an arcing instrument arm.
Reference-driven orbit rocker: a suspended seat with ring-like side growth and a narrow support chassis under it.
Extreme gantry throne: a compact seat shell under an oversized rear fin and two long instrument arms that turn the chair into a medical altar.
Extreme blossom bed: a low central cushion is engulfed by oversized petal walls and a wide service plinth.
Extreme harness lounger: a reclined shell with wrapped side bands, a rear cradle, and a long hanging service arm.
Extreme cathedral perch: a narrow operative seat with giant rear buttress, stacked front plinths, and a thin surveillance arm above.
Extreme shrine bed: a low sleeping plinth wrapped by one huge rear slab and one smaller side slab, as if the furniture were also an altar wall.
Extreme pincer chair: a narrow seat with two oversized opposing side jaws and a small rear counter-shell, halfway between lounge chair and clamp.
Extreme gallows perch: a tiny operative seat under a very large overhanging arm and a severe rear shell, more device than chair.
Extreme triptych bed: a central pad and three surrounding leaf-panels produce something between bed, stage, and mechanical flower.
History-modernism pass: a faceted cantilever chair with sled-base logic, compact seat, and upright back in a Bauhaus register.
History-modernism pass: an Art Deco club chair with a heavy plinth, rounded side blocks, and a tall stepped back.
History-modernism pass: a Memphis-like divider or shelving object with asymmetrical bays, pastel planes, and a totemic center spine.
History-modernism pass: a low modernist daybed with a strong horizontal plinth, offset head bolster, and one guarding side plane.
History-modernism pass: a postmodern shelf-object with stacked display bays, one exaggerated side blade, and a shallow stage base.
Sci-fi props pass: a command console with a low pedestal, recessed front panel grid, and a tilted readout slab.
Sci-fi props pass: a cryo pod or med-bay sarcophagus with a thick plinth, raised bed, and one large lid slab.
Sci-fi props pass: a reactor or power core pedestal with vertical body, side fins, and a crowned top emitter.
Sci-fi props pass: a standing airlock or portal frame with a recessed front face and heavy side shoulders.
Sci-fi props pass: a small beacon or sensor mast with stepped base, vertical spine, and top cluster like a signal lantern.
Creature pass: the command console becomes a low crab-like rover with four legs, a blunt sensor face, and folded side shields.
Creature pass: the cryo pod becomes a shell-backed beetle with six short legs and one heavy dorsal cover.
Creature pass: the reactor pedestal becomes an idol-like tower beast with a narrow head, side fins, and a ritual crown.
Creature pass: the airlock frame becomes a tall grazing walker with a plate face, heavy shoulders, and four planted legs.
Creature pass: the beacon tower becomes a narrow heron-like sentry with long legs, a high neck, and one signal crown as a head.
